title: rhynchostele × humeana
intro: Rhynchostele × humeana, commonly known as the Humeara orchid, is a hybrid orchid species derived from the cross between Rhynchostele rosalinda and Brachtia pulchella. It is prized for its vibrant flowers and is used in traditional medicine. The Humeara orchid has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in the Humeara orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as relaxing and soothing the nervous system, and providing antimicrobial and antifungal activities.
